author: Claude Code (sole code writer)
exposure: Adaptive development on an inspected train set; Task010-012 train results known, including the Task012 PUMP-04 flow-noise budget detail. No Task013 raw residual values or scores known. Phase 1 read no benchmark raw telemetry, minute features, snapshots or labels; the partition loader was tested only on a synthetic temporary tree. Phase 1 overlapped with the read-only Task012 audit in a separate process; Task012 results were preserved unchanged after it completed.

data_scope.raw_loader: only files under telemetry/asset_id=<train ID>/ (per-asset rglob; asset_id/day restored from the hive path relative to the telemetry root); columns timestamp_utc, operating_mode, sample_interval_s, discharge_pressure_kpa, suction_pressure_kpa, flow_m3_h, motor_speed_rpm; IDs, parseable timestamps and window bounds asserted; assets lacking a required installed channel skipped with an explicit capability reason
data_scope.allowed_shared_static: assets.csv parsed then train-filtered; shared parquet via train predicates; benign filtered to train
forbidden: validation PUMP-08/09 and test PUMP-10..12 telemetry/snapshots/labels/predictions

emission: unchanged causal B1 (k=6, persistence 15, 24 h reference, 12 h refractory), PYTHONHASHSEED=0 at start

candidates.R3: std(E) > 3.0 x first-day median reference AND unique covariance attribution
candidates.E995: same as R3 except the excess test: empirical first-day upper-tail rank (1+b)/(N+1) <= 0.005, N >= 199
candidates.Y3: R3; on abstention and B1 UNKNOWN, unchanged Task010 W1
candidates.Y5: R5 with the same W1 fallback
candidates.Z995: E995 with the same W1 fallback

protected_and_scope: B1 COMMUNICATION_LOSS / SENSOR_STUCK not evaluated; W1 refines only B1 UNKNOWN on residual abstention; no residual-mean inference; no wear/cavitation diagnosis from this rule
applicability: Task012 hydraulic_check reused unchanged (water-like fluid, passport, reference complete, steady/no gap, observed Q/Ps/Pd/n/T, ratio bounds, relative std bounds, curve consistency 20 %, NIST Antoine, NPSH margin 1.5, not B1 cavitation/air) and recorded separately as rule_detail.applicability; Task012 budgets/floors are not a decision gate

residual.E: Xpd + Xps + Xq + Xn = measured pressure rise - public-curve pressure rise [kPa]
residual.assumptions: as Task012 (water-like, rho, g, atmosphere for applicability, equal taps, no velocity head)
residual.minute: [start, start+1 min) available only at its end; a raw row exactly at a minute end belongs to the next minute; rows >= the clock never enter
residual.pairing: rows with operating_mode RUNNING, Q/Ps/Pd/n all finite, Q > 0, n > 0; nothing filled or interpolated; >= 30 paired rows
residual.invalid: missing/unparseable timestamp -> explicit error; minute with duplicate timestamp / off-grid (sub-second) timestamp / sample_interval_s != 1 -> invalid_reason and no statistics
residual.statistics: double precision; centred within the same paired rows; variances/covariances ddof=1
residual.reference: first-24h closed minutes with g.steady, no gap, valid, paired >= 30, finite std(E) >= 0 (explicit boolean mask); R: >= 60 minutes and median > 0; E995: >= 199 minutes and median > 0; never exposed in evidence of an alert before reference end (status incomplete); the full reference distribution is never written to evidence
residual.excess_E995: b = #reference std(E) >= current std(E) (ties count against); tail_rank = (1+b)/(N+1) <= 0.005; not a fault probability, valid p-value or calibrated false-alarm rate
residual.decomposition: c_j = Cov(E, X_j)/Var(E); Var(E) > 0; |sum c_j - 1| <= 1e-6; every c_j >= -0.25 (else strong_cancellation); exactly one c_j >= 0.75 and all others <= 0.25 (else no_unique_dominant_term); dominant speed -> abstain; source spread z > 6 (strict) for Q/Ps/Pd
residual.evidence: minute bounds, paired/total/running rows, raw provenance, std/var/mean of E (kPa, kPa^2), reference (median kPa, support) or tail (N, b, rank, limit, median), all four native covariances (kPa^2), term variances, shares and sum, source spread z, applicability values/reasons/assumptions, original B1 cause; confidence = retained B1 anomaly score, not a confidence in the proposed cause

gates.success: detected>=18, class>=14, false+excess<=6, sensor type+channel>=3, AND (type>=10 OR (type>=9 AND sensor type+channel>=4))
gates.selection: useful diagnoses desc, correct type desc, false+excess asc, then R3 < R5 < E995 < Y3 < Y5 < Z995
correctness: control semantic equality and expected metrics
emission multiset equal to control for all 7

full-evidence prefix + future mutation (minute means, std/min/max, counts, snapshots and future residual-table statistics) at the Task010 cut set for all 7 candidates; None/NaN-normalised comparison of every column

independent raw-aggregation checks per raw asset at reference end -1/0/+1 s, first post-reference alert boundary and one sub-minute cut: truncated raw and future-mutated raw (values x3+50, mode STOPPED) must reproduce every closed-minute statistic incl. counts and invalid/absent rows
main prediction hash equals a fresh PYTHONHASHSEED=0 child
gates.validation_policy: only a single train-selected candidate may later be considered under Task014; never validation-based selection

runner.before_scoring: run_provenance.json (manifest/code hashes, train input projection hashes, raw projection hashes per asset, aggregation provenance incl. invalid-minute counts, prediction hashes) + raw predictions + applicability_coverage.csv
runner.attempts: new results/synchronized_residual/run-<UTC>/ per attempt; partial runs preserved; COMPLETED.json blocks a second score

reviews: docs/tasks/013-review-round1.md: per-alert incomplete reference before reference end (fixture: early non-protected UNKNOWN alert, full vs prefix vs future-mutated raw); native kPa^2 covariances; explicit missing/unparseable timestamp rejection; partition loader tested on a synthetic tree
docs/tasks/013-review-round2.md: explicit boolean reference mask; zero-eligible-reference fixture for factor and empirical candidates; runner coverage fixture covers all six
